## Validation

- [ ] Targeted local/source tests pass
- [ ] Relevant Windows/Linux acceptance evidence is linked
- [ ] Any skipped/TODO tests are justified by the approved acceptance contract
- [ ] Artifact upload and evidence retention requirements are satisfied or explicitly blocked
- [ ] No unnecessary installer build or release tag

## Safety and change control

- [ ] No credentials, profile data, or generated binaries committed
- [ ] Existing approved M1 baseline preserved
- [ ] M2/M3 or other unfinished milestones excluded unless specifically in scope
- [ ] Security, persistence, API, and data migration impacts reviewed
- [ ] CI and workflow changes explicitly documented
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` / documentation updated if applicable

## Risks / blockers

State unresolved blockers and whether they prevent merge.

## Rollback

Describe the merge commit or release tag to revert if needed.
